title: Writer invented a rounded bound absent from the evidence

found.context: Phase 9 drafts of a public benchmark paper

observed_failure: Drafts said models were 'under 350 KB' / 'under 330 KB' while the evidence gives a maximum of 325 KB; readers could not recover the real maximum.
expected_behavior: Every number in a draft traces to a source value (allowing only its own rounding); invented bounds are flagged.
